items.title: File Einspruch against the 2023 income tax assessment
items.quote: Wer mit dieser Festsetzung nicht einverstanden ist, kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispieltal-Süd erheben – schriftlich, elektronisch über ELSTER oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 24.12.2024, sent by post. Under §122(2) Nr.1 AO a postally sent notice is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 3rd day after posting, unless it did not arrive or arrived later. Counting calendar days from 24.12.2024: 25.12 (day1, 1. Weihnachtstag), 26.12 (day2, 2. Weihnachtstag), 27.12.2024 (day3, Friday) = deemed Bekanntgabe day. 27.12.2024 is not itself a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, so no shift is needed. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§355 AO) begins the day after the triggering event per §187(1) BGB i.V.m. §108(1) AO, i.e. 28.12.2024, but per §188(2) BGB a month-long period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the day on which the triggering event (Bekanntgabe) fell, i.e. the 27th. The next '27th' is 27.01.2025 (a Monday), which is not a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg or federally, so the deadline is not shifted further. Note: the sending Finanzamt and the taxpayer's address use postcodes in the 73xxx range (Baden-Württemberg), so Baden-Württemberg holidays were checked, but no Land-specific holiday falls on the relevant dates.

warnings: The sender's and recipient's names and places (Finanzamt Beispieltal-Süd, Musterlingen am Neckar, Laura Beispielwinkel) read like generic placeholder/example names rather than a real authority and address — worth double-checking that this is a genuine Finanzamt letter about a real person before acting on it.
The letter states a refund of 667,00 € is due to the taxpayer but gives no date or bank details for when/how this will be paid out; no action item could be dated for this.

The notice-of-delivery fiction (dritter Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post) was computed assuming the letter was actually posted on its printed date (24.12.2024); if actual postage occurred later, the Bekanntgabe date and hence the Einspruch deadline shift accordingly.
